_about: Synthetic recording of the verification of p-http-duration-userid (`make fixtures-synth`, server/server/verify_synth.py): Grail answers for the volume and reference queries and the Dynatrace MCP execute_dql answer for new Davis problems. The MCP result format is not documented; this uses a JSON text block. Replace with real recordings once a tenant exists.

volume.query:
timeseries before = count(http.server.request.duration), by: {user.id}, from: -60m, to: -30m
| append [timeseries after = count(http.server.request.duration), by: {user.id}, from: -30m]
| summarize before = countIf(isNotNull(user.id) and isNotNull(before)),
    after = countIf(isNotNull(user.id) and isNotNull(after))

alert:High latency frontend.query: timeseries p95 = percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95), by:{service.name, http.route}, filter: service.name == "frontend"

problems.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from: -30m
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter event.start >= now() - 30m
| fields display_id, event.name, event.status, event.category, event.start
